$comment: Step S4b's inventory (docs/design/output-and-languages.md §9.1, §9.3, §9.6, §16.1), written by node scripts/i18n/s4b-sites.mjs: every UI text the scanner's words rule (scripts/i18n/lib/scan.cjs, WORD_KINDS) finds still in English, as 'table' (a word table: labels, names, hints, notes and sentences in object and array literals, maps keyed by ids, getters), 'copy' (words a function returns or builds outside a table) and 'fragment' (a sentence made of pieces: it needs a merge group with a .whole message, §9.3, unless one message with a placeholder gives the same English). Each site is in one group; the groups' files are disjoint, so the builders of b, c and d never touch the same source file (allow.json and the English catalogues are shared). 'mirroredBy' names a renderer words file that already shows a main-side table in the UI language: such a table stays English as data (§9.5, §9.6) and goes to allow.json with that reason once the renderer shows only the words file's text. Text that is data (ids, AI prompts, file-format words, words in exported files) goes to allow.json with its reason; UI text never does. The other account's files are left out (pending, §9.5).
